steps.query:
with c as (select id from customers where is_test),
t as (select id from tickets where customer_id in (select id from c)),
r as (delete from replies where ticket_id in (select id from t) returning 1),
tk as (delete from tickets where id in (select id from t) returning 1),
k as (delete from api_keys where customer_id in (select id from c) returning 1),
cu as (delete from customers where id in (select id from c) returning 1)
select (select count(*) from r) replies,(select count(*) from tk) tickets,(select count(*) from k) api_keys,(select count(*) from cu) customers
